summary_markdown:
### Northwind Teams launch
- Launch depends on Falcon being live

### Slack thread and connection pool and incident review
- Slack thread is fine in theory
- Connection pool: it seems to come and go
  - No clear owner for connection pool
  - Connection pool is pretty close
- Incident review is pretty solid
  - Incident review is kind of a mystery
  - Incident review and read replicas seen as one underlying problem
- Preference to do a proper write-up rather than pair on it

### Runbook and follow ups and rate limiter
- Suggestion to pair on it before touching runbook
- Follow ups is good enough for now
  - Follow ups is better than last week
- Rate limiter is the obvious next thing

### Flaky integration tests and api versioning and error budget
- Flaky integration tests is mostly fine
- Api versioning is the blocker
- No clear owner for error budget
  - Error budget is weirdly controversial

### Test fixtures and handoff and backlog
- Test fixtures is basically done
- Concern with handoff: that we're too optimistic
- Backlog is kind of stuck
  - Backlog and timeout settings seen as one underlying problem

### Retry logic and load test and pagination bug
- Suggestion to set up a short sync before touching retry logic
- Load test is half done
- Real issue may be retry logic rather than pagination bug
